title: Can the consumers drain the queue after an outage?
description: Model steady-state capacity, FIFO message-group parallelism, batching pressure, and the backlog created while workers are unavailable.

workloads.label: Transactional email
workloads.detail: Small, independent jobs with a fast downstream API and no useful global ordering.

workloads.label: Image thumbnails
workloads.detail: Moderate payloads and CPU-heavy work. Bursts should wait in the queue instead of exhausting the web tier.

workloads.label: Account commands
workloads.detail: Updates must remain ordered per account, but unrelated accounts can run concurrently in separate message groups.

workloads.label: Document analysis
workloads.detail: Large messages and slow inference make worker headroom and payload offloading explicit design concerns.
